original_intent: Resolve PR #1344 merge conflicts and remove obsolete repository-native Buildkite files now that Buildkite's GitHub Actions migration is implemented.
derived_intent: Keep all .github/workflows/*.yml unchanged as the sole workflow contract, remove .buildkite, preserve current master changes, and document the service-owned Buildkite migration boundary.
active_boundaries: Do not modify or delete .github/workflows/*.yml; do not add a second pipeline source; resolve conflicts against current master; remove only obsolete .buildkite files.
repo_scope: PR #1344 merge resolution, .buildkite removal, governed specs, plan, trajectory, and issue/PR narrative
evidence: Latest PR #1344 checks: buildkite/decapod passed in Buildkite #88; validate-constitution passed; external buildkite/ci Build #90 failed after 1 second. Public Buildkite logs require authentication, so the adapter/configuration failure remains externally unlocalized.

Merged current master v0.103.0 into PR #1344; generated governance and projections were resolved to current master, the two obsolete .buildkite files were deleted, and .github/workflows files were not authored by this change.
